spec: Sticker-style game icon. Thick dark ink outline #1A0E06 (about 5% of icon width), rounded corners. Hard drop shadow in the same ink colour offset straight down about 4%, no blur. Fill with a vertical two-colour gradient (light top, rich bottom) plus one glossy highlight shape at the top left (white 25-35%). Light from the top left, slightly chubby bevelled volume. Keep size, outline weight and angle consistent within a set. Subject centred inside an 80% safe area.
